item.title: Album Low Roar-0
item.description:
Muy recientemente empezamos a charlar con los chicos sobre la implementacion de un reproductor de mp3 en el blog, entonces me puse a investigar varias opciones, ninguna realmente interesante para implementarla. Termine en Internet Archive buscando un host para hotlinkear el contenido para no tener que tenerlo como estatico dentro del blog. Termine encontrandome con que Internet Archive tiene visualizacion de WebAmp, una forma de mostrar Winamp en la Web.

En su momento hable con los chicos de hacer algo similar a Winamp pero nunca me cruce con WebAmp, hasta este momento.

item.title: La Ruta De Apostoles a Encarnacion
item.description:
La idea de este post es documentar el trayecto de Apostoles (Misiones, Argentina), a Encarnacion (Paraguay). Ire actualizando el post con base a los viajes que vaya haciendo por esta ruta, ya que me parece particularmente bella.

Misiones es una provincia al norte de Argentina, limitrofe de Paraguay y Brasil (Y parte de la triple frontera con estos paises).

Una peculiaridad de la tierra misionera es su color rojo, a lo largo de las imagenes se va a ver como en ciertas partes la tierra toma un tono carmesi.

item.title: Little Drawings
item.description:
Intro

I dont consider myself an artist but I recently started doing little drawings in this neat notebook I got. Its quite fun doing these drawings and I just wanted to share them here.

Drawing

I started doing these little guys at school, It first was me just passing the time and scribbling in the edges of the pages of my school notebook. I liked making them look like prehistoric cave paintings (idk why it just seemed cool) and I have no pictures of these since those pages are now lost (thank my mother for that). I developed a sort of story for these guys where they are just chilling and a shape comes to them and they worship it.

item.title: Pylot-The Carbon Ghost
item.description:
Intro

For some context, there’s a band called Pylot and they make electronic synthwavey music. Ive liked the music they put out for a while, my brother showed them to me like 5-6 years ago and I have not stopped listening to them.

They released a new LP (LP = album too short to be a album) and I just wanted to share my thoughts.

The links to every song and album are on the names of each respective one, I expect you to listen to each one, if you like it or not is your deal but LISTEN TO THEM.

item.title: Photography trip
item.description:
Intro

This happened almost a month ago from when im posting this. Brenda (my girlfriend) had come to visit and she brought her camara for the purpose of taking cool pictures in some location, so I got in contact with my aunts husband which we call bebbeo to plan a little excursion somewhere cool since he is a professional photographer.

We came to the conclusion that this trip would be held in El Bosque De Chapultepec,so we made a date. The day arrived and so did we in his apartment, the members of this adventure were Brenda, Sebastian (my brother), Bebbeo, Leondario (my little cousin and son of bebbeo) and myself.

item.title: Sobre La Creacion De Sitios Con Hugo
item.description: La cuestion es la siguiente, hoy en dia no queremos usar html y css crudo, cuando podemos usar una capa de abstraccion1 como Hugo. Esta capa de abstraccion nos permite trabajar en un blog como este, sin un conocimiento denso y tedioso en el manejo de lenguajes de etiqueta o escritura innecesaria de boilerplate. Por lo que es el equivalente a usar unos pocos comandos y manejarse con markdown, algo simple de entender tambien.
